name: Hilsa
desc: A plankton-feeding fish that lives in estuaries and swims up rivers to spawn. It is Bangladesh's national fish.
about: The ilish (Bengali: ইলিশ, romanized: iliś), also known as the ilishi, hilsa, pulasa, hilsa herring or hilsa shad, is a species of fish related to the herring, in the family Clupeidae.
